method: Owned local Chrome review queue. Per trial reset, two animation frames, 50 ms settling and focus/ownership checks outside timer. Alternating grayscale states and a unique 16-bit black/white trial code verify frame freshness with exact colors. The 1x1 case can verify only the alternating state; larger captures verify the code too. Exact magenta target search. Capture timer is capture call only; full-loop timer includes first capture, freshness assertion, exact public findColor, coordinate mapping, native move/click, fresh captures until visible after-token. Both mouse delays explicitly matched (0 or 10 ms per call). No polling sleep. Visible-response deadline 1 second; incomplete loops retain timing but are excluded from successful-latency medians. Five failed preflight calls mark a backend/case unavailable rather than retrying hundreds of known failures. DOM receipts independently verify exactly one trusted click inside target, no focus loss. No retries or recording. Fresh process per backend/round/case, five excluded warmups; six alternating rounds of 20 measured trials. Capture/search/input/render latency and any failed attempts retained. Launch/reset/IPC/DOM receipts excluded from driver timer.
